meta.title: {product} — an exclusive community of vetted designers
meta.description: Designers get ghosted. Companies drown in applications they can't judge. {product} fixes hiring at the root: designers vetted by designers, a clear process and timeline for every role, and accountability on both sides.

hero.headline:
Hiring is broken.

On both sides.
hero.subheadline: Designers get ghosted. Companies drown in applications they can't judge. {product} fixes hiring at the root: designers vetted by designers, a clear process and timeline for every role, and accountability on both sides.

items.review: Real designers review your work, not an algorithm
items.profile: A professional profile with case studies, instead of another resume file
items.answers: Companies that commit to answering, with a reason and on time
items.control: You decide what to share, and with whom

steps.apply: Apply with your portfolio and LinkedIn
steps.review: Our team of designers reviews it personally and gets back to you within 7 days
steps.profile: Approved? Build your profile, and companies will be able to find you

notAgency.title: Not a hiring agency
notAgency.lead: We don't place, introduce or recommend candidates.
notAgency.body: This is an exclusive community of vetted designers, where designers and companies find each other directly. Companies search and reach out on their own, and designers decide who to talk to. We set the rules both sides agree to, and make sure they're kept.

audience.title: Who it's for
audience.body: Product, UX/UI and web designers with real, shipped work. Years matter less than the work itself: if you're early in your career, you're welcome too, as long as your portfolio shows strong skills and real projects.

founding.title: Founding members
founding.body: We're starting small: first we're building the designer community, and companies join next. The first designers will help shape how this works.

form.title: Apply to join
form.intro: It takes about three minutes. Fields marked as optional can be left empty.

fields.confidential: My search is confidential (I'm currently employed)
fields.own_work: All work in my portfolio is my own, or clearly credited
fields.consent: I've read the <link>privacy policy</link> and agree to my details being stored to use the platform

form.goodToKnow: Joining doesn't guarantee a job. Companies on the platform search and reach out to designers themselves. What is guaranteed: a real answer to your application, never silence.
form.notConnected: The form isn't connected yet. Submissions will work in the next build stage.

errors.invalidUrl: Enter a full link, for example https://yourportfolio.com
errors.invalidLinkedin: Enter a LinkedIn profile link, for example https://www.linkedin.com/in/yourname
errors.duplicate: We already have an application from this email.
errors.tooFast: That was quick. Please take a moment and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

privacyNotice.title: Your privacy
privacyNotice.body: We collect only what's needed to review your application: the details in this form and links to your work. Only our review team sees them during review. Providing them is voluntary, and you can ask to have them deleted at any time.

thanks.title: Thanks for applying.
thanks.body: We review every portfolio personally and will get back to you within 7 days.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Short and plain: what we store, why, and what you control.

what.title: What we store
what.body: The details you entered in the form, links to your portfolio and LinkedIn, and later, the content you add to your profile.

why.title: Why
why.body: To review your application and, once approved, to show your profile to companies on the platform.

who.title: Who sees it
who.body: Only our review team during review. After approval, registered companies see your profile according to the privacy settings you choose. Phone and email are shown only if you choose to.

control.title: Your control
control.body: You can view, correct or delete your data at any time, from your profile or by email.

footer.notAgency: Not a recruitment or placement agency. Designers and companies find each other directly.

declineReason.no_process_case_studies: Portfolio doesn't include case studies that show process
declineReason.outside_focus: Most work is outside the platform's current focus
declineReason.not_enough_real_work: Portfolio doesn't yet show enough real project work
